target: 100% client-visible feature and behavior parity with the last supported classic Skype for Business FULL Windows desktop client for configured on-premises Skype for Business Server 2019 / Subscription Edition, including Full-only features and Windows platform integrations. Feature testability depends on active policies, licensing and services, not a waiver.
baseline: Minimum: each independent scenario in WINDOWS_REFERENCE_CASES.json derived from Microsoft Windows Full client feature comparison; expand with actual reference Windows build behavioral inventory, release-specific features, policy/failure edge cases. Refuse v1.0 until frozen reference versions, source revisions, automated evidence and human signoff exist.
release_policy: Fail closed: Windows reference case list must be complete, each case has its own real-server interop evidence; every FEATURE_PARITY feature verified with local+real evidence, exact Windows-build inventory and signed-off manual differences review. Offline demos do not count.
